plot_summary:
Theo Appleseed is the protagonist. On Monday Morning, July 29, 2024 at 7:30 am, Theo Appleseed were involved. Theo has a booked train trip to Chicago. Leaving tomorrow at 15:07 pm from the Central Station.
 generate calendar_events for the plot. In the calender event added a note for saving 1h travel time from office. Also he received the ticket number and booking reference number through messages for the train ticket.
user_goal: You want to hear what the message from your train service says.

success_conditions.input_text: 1. The message from booking@trainservice.com is read to user.

messages.content: Dear Theo, your train ticket to Chicago is booked. Departure: July 30, 2024, 15:07 from Central Station. Ticket number: TK123456789, Booking reference: BR987654321.

query: Read my message I just got from the train service please
reasoning: User wants me to read a message from the train service I see a recent message from Train Service in their conversations. I will read this message to user.
